verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a public, OpenAI-compatible HTTP API at https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai. The docs cover setup steps (base_url, api_key, model) and request parameters such as service_tier (priority/flex), fail_fast and reasoning_effort, so an AI-native user can drive inference programmatically with standard SDKs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the candidate paths all returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API usage, and documented API coverage for non-inference operations such as managing private deployments.
